treatments.title: FUE Hair Transplant
treatments.excerpt: Follicle-based extraction with micro motor. Scarless, naturally oriented transplantation.
treatments.description: The FUE technique we apply at our Gaziantep hair transplant center involves extracting grafts one by one from the donor area using micro motors. With natural hairline design and personalized density planning, we offer permanent, aesthetic, and painless results. Under the leadership of Hair Transplant Specialist Halil Çetin, we safely reach the highest graft count by protecting your donor area and providing a lifelong solution to your hair loss problem.
treatments.contentHtml:
What is FUE Hair Transplant?

FUE (Follicular Unit Extraction) is a minimally invasive hair restoration method, widely known and applied in the hair transplant world. Accepted as the gold standard in Gaziantep and worldwide, hair follicles in the donor area are collected one by one using special micro-motor punches without damaging the surrounding tissue.

Advantages of the FUE Technique

  • No Scars: Unlike the classic FUT method, no incision is made in the skin, so no stitch scar remains on the nape after the operation.
  • Fast Recovery: Thanks to minimal tissue damage, the return to daily life is extremely fast.
  • High Graft Count: It offers the opportunity to transplant up to 4,500 to 5,000 grafts (approximately 10,000 - 12,500 hairs) in a single session.
  • Natural Results: The extracted roots are placed in micro-channels opened in the shedding area in accordance with the natural direction of hair growth.

FUE with the Halil Çetin Difference

Hair Transplant Specialist Halil Çetin and his team use special solutions that maximize the survival time of grafts in FUE operations. The patient's front hairline is designed personally according to golden ratio principles. By strictly avoiding asymmetric drawings or uniform "factory production" hairlines, the profile most suitable for the person's age and facial anatomy is obtained.

treatments.title: DHI Hair Transplant
treatments.excerpt: Implantation without opening channels using a Choi implanter. More controlled angle and density.
treatments.description: DHI (Direct Hair Implantation) is an innovative method in which hair follicles are placed directly under the skin without opening a channel, using special Choi pens. It is especially ideal for our patients seeking unshaven hair transplantation and densification among existing hair in Gaziantep. This technique allows us to perfectly control the angle and direction of the hair follicle, allowing us to achieve a completely natural look. Since tissue damage is minimal, the recovery process is very fast.
treatments.contentHtml:
What is DHI Hair Transplant (Direct Hair Implantation)?

DHI (Direct Hair Implantation) is one of the latest points reached in hair transplant technology. Special medical pens called Choi Pen are used in this technique. Its biggest feature is that it allows the channel opening and hair follicle placement process to be done at the same time.

Why Should You Choose the DHI Technique?

  • Unshaven Hair Transplant Opportunity: Ideal especially for women or executives/professionals who do not want their hair completely cut. Options are offered to shave only the donor area or completely unshaven transplantation.
  • High Density: Thanks to the fine-tipped Choi pens, hair follicles can be planted much closer to each other, providing excellent density in narrow areas.
  • Minimum Trauma and Bleeding: Since no channel is opened beforehand, damage to the skin is minimal. The healing process is much faster.

Operation Process and Reliability

The DHI technique requires much higher manual dexterity, experience, and team coordination compared to other methods. With 24 years of experience, Halil Çetin and his expert team carry out DHI operations with zero error tolerance. The survival rate of the hair after transplantation is over 98%.

treatments.title: Sapphire FUE
treatments.excerpt: Sapphire-tipped channels. Thinner incisions, faster healing surface.
treatments.description: Sapphire FUE hair transplant is a premium procedure that uses smooth and ultra-sharp tips made of real sapphire ore instead of classic metal tips. With this advanced method applied in our Gaziantep hair transplant clinic, tissue trauma is minimized and micro-channels are opened at microscopic sizes perfectly compatible with the hair follicle. Sapphire FUE, which enables you to achieve denser, thicker, and natural hair with a much faster healing process, offers a highly comfortable operation experience.
treatments.contentHtml:
What is Sapphire FUE?

Sapphire FUE is a much more innovative and tissue-friendly version of the classic FUE method. When opening channels (slots) in the area to be transplanted, very sharp and smooth tips produced from real natural sapphire stone are used instead of traditional steel slits.

Medical Advantages of Sapphire FUE

  • Smoother Channels: Thanks to the antibacterial surface and V-shaped structure of the sapphire blades, much smaller and flawless channels are opened in the skin.
  • Better Retention of Roots: Since the channels are opened perfectly matching the size of the hair follicles, the risk of the grafts (roots) moving or their angles being distorted is eliminated.
  • Tighter and Denser Transplantation: Thanks to the thinness of the tips, the number of hair follicles per square centimeter can be increased.
  • Less Edema: Compared to classic methods, much less fluid is injected into the scalp, and because tissue trauma is reduced, postoperative swelling (edema) remains at a minimum level.

The Peak of Naturalness with Sapphire FUE

In our clinic, the Sapphire FUE technique is the first choice, especially for our patients with large openings in the forehead and crown areas. At the Halil Çetin Hair Transplant clinic, in accordance with international ISHRS standards, the highest quality sapphire tips are used for a single patient and then destroyed.

process.title: 1. Analysis & Consultation
process.body: Your hair loss stage, donor area capacity, and graft needs are analyzed in detail by our expert team. By listening to your expectations, the most suitable transplant plan is created for you.

process.title: 2. Personalized Design
process.body: Considering your facial features, golden ratio, and muscle structure, the front line, beard, or eyebrow contour is designed to give the most natural appearance. The operation never starts without mutual approval.

process.title: 3. Painless Graft Extraction
process.body: After comfortable local anesthesia, healthy hair follicles (grafts) are collected one by one from the donor area with micro-motors. To preserve cell viability, the roots are kept in special solutions.

process.title: 4. Micro-Channel and Implantation
process.body: According to the selected method (Sapphire FUE or DHI), roots are placed by calculating the natural growth direction, angle, and depth. Maximum naturalness is targeted, especially in the front line.

process.title: 5. First Wash and Recovery
process.body: Your first wash after the operation is done carefully in the clinic. Scabbing is overcome within 10 days with special lotions given to you. During this process, our experts follow you step by step via WhatsApp.

process.title: 6. Shock Loss and Final Result
process.body: After the temporary 'shock loss' experienced in the first month, your new roots start to sprout permanently from the 3rd month. At the end of 12 months, you achieve that perfect, thick, and natural look planned.

faqs.question: Is hair transplantation permanent?
faqs.answer: Follicles taken from the donor area are genetically resistant to shedding. With proper planning and donor protection, transplanted grafts are permanent. Medical support may be required for future shedding.

faqs.question: FUE or DHI?
faqs.answer: FUE / Sapphire FUE stands out for large areas and high graft counts; DHI stands out for the hairline, densification, and the need to protect existing hair. The decision is made after analysis.

faqs.question: When can I return to work?
faqs.answer: For desk jobs, 3-5 days are usually sufficient. Scabs fall off within 10 days. Heavy sports are delayed for 1 month.

faqs.question: Is shock loss normal?
faqs.answer: Yes. Transplanted hair may temporarily shed between the 2nd and 8th weeks. New growth starts from the 3rd month, final density is seen in the 12th month.

faqs.question: Do you accept patients from abroad?
faqs.answer: Yes. We offer online photo analysis, transfer, and accommodation coordination. You just need to be in Gaziantep on the day of the operation.

about.title: Hair Transplant Specialist
about.heroText: Hair transplantation is not just a surgical procedure, it is the perfect combination of medicine and aesthetic vision. Trust experienced hands for natural, permanent and undetectable results.

section1.title: The Perfect Combination of Aesthetics and Medicine
section1.p1: Serving patients from all over Turkey and Europe at his Gaziantep-based clinic, Hair Transplant Specialist Halil Çetin is one of the most preferred and trusted names in the region in the field of hair restoration.
section1.p2: In his professional life of over 24 years, he has personally managed the hair, beard and eyebrow transplant operations of over 10,000 patients, and made positive touches to the lives and self-confidence of thousands of people. Unlike ordinary hair transplant centers working with a "mass production" logic, Halil Çetin adopts a "boutique and personalized" treatment protocol.
section1.p3: He applies Sapphire FUE and DHI (Direct Hair Implantation) technologies, which maximize the success rate in hair transplant operations, with the latest devices.

section2.title: Precision on the Operation Table
section2.p1: The secret to a successful hair transplant is not just collecting and transplanting the roots. The angle, depth, and front hairline design at which the roots are planted is the real differentiating factor. Halil Çetin works with the meticulousness of an artist on the operating table.
section2.p2: The hairline design, planned in accordance with the golden ratio rules, is drawn using laser rulers according to the patient's age, facial anatomy and expectations. During the procedure, each graft (hair follicle) taken from the donor area is transferred to its new home by keeping it in the most suitable solutions without losing its vitality.
